description: Declared Cloudflare API token policy for Andrew D. Horowitz's account. This file is the policy of record: cf_token_converge.py (same directory) compares the live tokens against it and, on Andrew's kickoff, additively applies any missing declared groups (v1 never removes; undeclared live groups are reported as drift, never deleted). A privilege that exists live but is not declared here IS drift and the check run reports it. Ruled one-by-one in the main chat, 2026-11-05.

tokens._verified_effective: User -> API Tokens -> Edit (single permission, set at creation 2026-11-05; Edit covers reading tokens). No expiration — Andrew ruled 2026-11-05 to amend the policy to no-expiry for this token (the Feb 2027 expiry recorded earlier sat on the deleted cfat_ account token, not this one).
tokens.kill_path: Cloudflare dashboard -> My Profile -> API Tokens -> 'Token Admin — owner only' -> Delete. Revoking it kills only token administration; it holds no other power.
tokens.name: Token Admin — owner only
tokens.note: Skeleton key by design and by ruling: its ONLY power is administering Andrew's other Cloudflare tokens. It lives only in 1Password and is used only from Termux on Andrew's phone. It never enters Muse's credential store, GitHub, or chat. The converger uses it as its runtime credential and must NEVER modify this token (report_only + hard guard in the script). A user token is the required kind: account-owned tokens cannot hold the API Tokens permission or administer user tokens.
tokens.storage: 1Password (API Credential item 'Cloudflare Token Admin — owner only')

_verified_effective._note: Reference only — the converger compares declared groups, not these strings. Captured from live probes on 2026-11-05.
account_reads_probe_verified_2026-11-05: GET /accounts/{id}/rum/site_info/list OK (Account Settings Read) — 3 Web Analytics sites
GraphQL rumPageloadEventsAdaptiveGroups OK (Account Analytics Read) — 187 pageloads 2026-11-03..05

tokens.kill_path: Cloudflare dashboard -> My Profile -> API Tokens -> 'Muse — andrewdhorowitz.com' -> Delete; then reconnect the custom.cloudflare connector with a replacement token.
tokens.name: Muse — andrewdhorowitz.com
tokens.note: Muse's working fleet token. Carries the working scopes plus the read/check scopes ruled in on 2026-11-04/05 (Registrar, Email Routing, Account Settings Read, Account Analytics Read; API Tokens Read at user and account level, ruled in 2026-11-05 for token-structure verification). Zone groups below are reverse-derived from the effective permissions returned by GET /zones (identical on all four zones) plus the account-level reads probe-verified on 2026-11-05.
tokens.storage: Muse's secure connection store (custom.cloudflare connector); the value never appears in this repo.

zones._note: Zone-scope groups are declared once and apply to every zone listed here.
